capabilities: Sync vault files and .obsidian settings two-way with Proton Drive
Detect three-way conflicts and keep the losing side as a conflict copy
Browse, compare and restore earlier Drive versions of a note
Exclude paths by glob and skip files above a size limit
Create view-only Proton public links for files
disambiguation: Not a developer SDK; it is a sync plugin built on Proton's official Drive SDK.
extras: Not yet in the community directory; install manually or via BRAT. The README warns the plugin writes to and can delete files in the vault and has no external audit, so a restorable backup is advised. GPL-3.0-or-later; no telemetry and no paid tiers.
intentEvidence: This is a fork of obsidian-proton-sync.
motivation: The fork exists to publish releases cut from a tested tree and to run the same sync engine headless on a Linux server.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to keep a vault in sync with Proton Drive, and a device that was offline cannot tell an edit it missed from one it made.

relations.evidence: This is a fork of obsidian-proton-sync.
The same engine runs as a daemon on a Linux server (ondreu/pss-daemon)

summary: Two-way end-to-end encrypted sync between a vault and a Proton Drive folder, with three-way conflict detection and version history.
